notes.title: Kickstarter Launched for Deadlane
notes.content:
Vscape Studios is proud to announce the launch of Deadlane's Kickstarter campaign. 

[previewyoutube=Y2eHemMt_0c;full][/previewyoutube]

Deadlane is a [b]survival horror/racing game which focuses on forcing players to hunt each other in order to avoid sudden death.  [/b]

The campaign was created in an attempt to accelerate the project's development and release the game in a timely manner.

Those interested in the project can [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vscapestudios/deadlane]buy an early copy[/url] of the game at an Early Bird discount price. Only 57 hours left! 


Other rewards featured in the campaign focus on empowering players through customization. New racer and monster skins, kart models and personalized decals/billboards. Check us out today and spread the word!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vscapestudios/deadlane]Kickstarter[/url]
